question: Can the actual microscopic QWZ to one-CAR theorem in the existing TFPT papers be composed with the original quarter fold to derive the neutral octic field, its adjoint and geometric Ward response, and which original seed identification remains?
assumptions: The existing source-specific microscopic CAR theorem with the actual filled QWZ sea, charged fields, adjoints and positive time.
The fixed original one-source fold, A map, quarter orientation and shared Wick/current reference; no freely fitted field map.
The local ultraviolet route evaluates the SAME universal Wick/divided-difference prescription at microscopic and continuum contractions.
The ground-state reduction assumes the FULL graded CAR image, the same gapped one-particle time and the same positive-energy OS vacuum representation.
The local P1 image proposition is conditional on a compatible local star monomorphism and the separate elliptic collar/domain/relative-action requirements.
leaves_open: The full graded local operator/time/reflection/seam interface from the original operational seed, or a state-compatible even image sufficient for the neutral mechanism.
The original collar reducing domain, ellipticity and finite relative action on the same source image.
A simultaneous lattice/UV limit and a complete microscopic stress-unitary convergence theorem.
Charged E8 field extension/exhaustion, physical instruments and interacting 3+1 dimensional reconstruction.
not_claimed: A complete TFPT solution or any physical gate closure.
A fundamental derivation of the lattice width or mass from the scalar c3.
That positive energy on the EVEN algebra alone selects its state.
A passed historical full test suite whose transitive full-file pin is stale.
summary_de: Der in den Papers vorhandene QWZ Grenzwertsatz wird mit dem Fold desselben CAR Kanals verbunden. Der neutrale Oktikoperator, sein Adjungiertes und der nichtverschwindende Energie64 Ward Wert folgen mit kontrolliertem iteriertem Grenzwert. Ein starker verschmierter Feldsatz folgt aus polynomialen Energieabschätzungen; die lokale Route behält gemeinsame Wick Gegen-terme und die Reihenfolge N, Glättung, Punktabstand. Der ursprüngliche P1 Anschluss braucht einen lokalen Operator und Zeitvergleich; globale Bulk Gleichsetzung und eine zusätzliche Zustandswahl nach voller CAR Zeitidentifikation sind unnötig. Die konkrete ursprüngliche Einbettung und Collarzulässigkeit bleiben offen.
scope: Fixed original width8/mass1/r1 QWZ top edge, its actual filled sea and positive time, unitary fold of the SAME one CAR channel, fixed original A=U+^T O^T M and shared current point-splitting/Wick prescription. Only neutral octic mechanism. Microscopic N limit precedes all continuum regulator removal. No full microscopic stress-unitary limit or charged E8 exhaustion.
kills: A global unitary identifying the entire P1 bulk with free CAR is necessary for the neutral boundary mechanism.
Eight extra freely chosen source copies or E8 charged/spinor extension are prerequisites for this neutral octic.
A nonzero point split alone makes point fermion fields bounded finite CAR words.
The v464 demonstration classifies the original collar from gap/chirality/reflection or spectral flow.
